notes: No candidate was cloned, built or analyzed. gh api reads only. Forbidden inputs not read.

Needs mix: stateless excalidraw; storage-only actual, pocketbase, navidrome; Postgres-only atuin, hapi-fhir; Postgres+worker linkding; Postgres+worker+storage invoiceshelf; Postgres+Redis+worker(+storage) pretix, sure. Runtimes: Python x2, Rust, Java, Ruby, PHP, Node x2, Go x2. No Deno/Bun candidate (no suitable single-app repo found in time).

Risk linkding: SQLite is the default; Postgres is optional via env; background tasks run as a separate supervisord process (worker label is by design, not by compose). No Dockerfile at repo root (docker/ directory holds Dockerfiles).
Risk pretix: license NOASSERTION (Apache-2.0 with additional terms); app code under src/pretix; Celery worker and Redis are optional in settings but normal in production; Dockerfile is at root.
Risk atuin: Rust workspace; server runs as atuin server start from crates; entryPoint is the CLI crates/atuin/src/main.rs; database is Postgres (server) or SQLite.
Risk hapi-fhir-jpaserver-starter: default DB is in-memory H2; Postgres is a config choice; a WAR/Spring Boot build with Maven; heavy JVM memory.

Risk sure: Rails app, we-promise/sure is the maintained community continuation of maybe-finance/maybe (GitHub fork=false for this repo); Sidekiq worker needs Redis; pushed continuously, large Rails app.
Risk invoiceshelf: default branch is 3.x (not master/main); Laravel with Vue frontend built by pnpm/vite; docker/ directory holds Dockerfiles, none at root; database may be MySQL, Postgres or SQLite.

Risk actual: Yarn monorepo; deployable sync-server is packages/sync-server; Dockerfile and sync-server.Dockerfile at root; SQLite files need persistent storage (storage label by data location, not S3).
Risk pocketbase: no root Dockerfile; the repo is a Go framework, runnable main is examples/base/main.go; embedded SQLite and local file storage. Label as storage need by local data dir.
Risk navidrome: SQLite DB and music library on filesystem; Go plus React UI built in Dockerfile; needs a mounted music folder, which may be seen as storage or an unsupported mount.
Risk excalidraw: Yarn monorepo, deployable app in excalidraw-app; Dockerfile builds static assets served by nginx; Firebase/collab server is external and optional.
CI: pretix check-runs include in_progress=5; sure includes waiting=1 (informational only).
